scope: Starter ledger only. This assigns divergence and exchange duties; it does not derive conservation, fifth-force safety, equivalence compatibility, or a final physical law.

operational_metaphor_boundary.rule: Token, credit, dashboard, and energy-bank accounting are operational metaphors or resource ledgers, not physical conservation law evidence.
